rationale: Present or unknown occupancy must not be normalized during represented motion
Recovery events must remain separate from any later fresh start
Unexpected or mismatched motion must remain explicit and latched
Represented motion outside immutable reviewed limits requires intervention
Missing stale malformed or contradictory sensing cannot establish normal state
Temporal ambiguity can associate old physical state with new intent
Request or acknowledgment must never be mistaken for successful physical stopping
Each decision must use one exact reviewed configuration identity
Restart must not erase a latch or initialize uncertainty as normal
Acknowledgment reset rearm recovery and fresh start require distinct authority
The untrusted production domain cannot administer its independent monitor
Logical separation is insufficient while shared dependencies remain unresolved
